$comment: Machine-readable section map for Scanbin. Created 2026-08-12. Sections are REVIEW UNITS, not folders - see docs/CODEMAP.md for why the filesystem is deliberately not reorganized to match. Consumed by scripts/check-section.mjs (npm run check:section <id>). Keep in sync with docs/CODEMAP.md.

sections.title: Scan core and count ledger
sections.owns: Scan intake, the count ledger, resolution, optimistic state, persistence, sync queue.
invariants: TOP-LEVEL LAW: every scan appears in the feed and counts. Scan 10 = count 10.
ensureProvisionalCount runs synchronously before any await. That ORDERING is the enforcement; there is no named guard.
markWrong is a quantity TRANSFER, never a delete.
idempotencyKey assigned once at scan time, reused on retry, never regenerated inside a retry branch.
Barcodes and part numbers are TEXT. No numeric coercion at any layer.
traps: scanStore.ts is ~8,800 lines. Grep for symbols; never read top to bottom.
Audited 2026-08-12: this file largely EARNS its size. Density here is documented history, not bloat.

sections.title: Decode ladder, AI, and spend
sections.owns: The cost-ordered decode ladder, providers, evidence verification, the daily cap and breaker.
invariants: Cheapest-first, pay-once: a rung that answered is never re-paid.
The daily cap charges ONLY paid rungs, exactly once per genuine compute (L12: never two paths of one request).
Gemini is permanently out of decode (GEMINI_DECODE_DISABLED, a hardcoded literal, not an env var).
A code not in the index continues through the ladder in EVERY environment; probes never dead-end (L16).
Evidence truth is decided by the app, never a provider self-claim.
Decode attaches identity only. It never blocks or hides a counted row.
traps: services/ai/decodeOrchestrator.ts is DEPRECATED (types only). The real orchestrator is server/decode/pipeline.ts.
Tests must never call live providers. IS_E2E=1 forces mock-only.

sections.title: UI and app shell
sections.owns: Client components, App Router pages, auth surface.
invariants: The scan input is focused by default; Enter submits; focus returns after every scan.
Dangerous actions stay away from the scanner focus flow.
No em dash or en dash in user-facing copy.
Client code never reads process.env.*_API_KEY (guarded transitively).
traps: Unit tests are NOT sufficient for customer-facing changes. Human-bot proof is required.

sections.title: Data, catalog, sync, knowledge
sections.owns: Firestore sync and tenancy, catalog and reconcile, CSV import/export, the tire and retail corpora.
invariants: Every record is scoped by businessId. Firestore rules derive the tenant from the document path.
Generated corpus artifacts are never hand-edited. Change the generator and rebuild.
Duplicate scans increment quantity; they never create duplicate product rows.
traps: 11 *.rules.test.ts files SELF-SKIP without a Firestore emulator. They are most of the '105 skipped' in a green run. A symbol used only by them LOOKS dead and is not.
build-tire-knowledge.mjs falls through to a 2-row bootstrap seed with no harvester snapshot. Guarded since 2026-08-12 (MIN_RETAINED_FRACTION); do not remove that guard.
Corpus meta is refreshed by npm run refresh:tire-meta, NOT by rerunning the generator.

sections.title: Scripts, gates, and docs
sections.owns: Build and ingest scripts, the proof gates, project documentation.
invariants: npm run proof:all is the honest gate. proof:local is BLIND to the node:test suites.
A new test file must be reachable by a runner. Adding it to vitest's exclude list without a node:test entry orphans it silently.
traps: 10 test files are vitest-excluded. 9 of them had NO runner at all until 2026-08-12.
The node:test leg runs with --test-concurrency=1 deliberately; the tire-db-repair suites flake under parallel load.
